mapper.update: UPDATE ck_shop_order SET del_flag = 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND order_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')

UPDATE ck_shop_order SET refund_amount = refund_amount + #{delta}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND paid_amount > 0 AND refund_amount + #{delta} <= paid_amount
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'WAIT_PAY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS waitPayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'WAIT_SHIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS waitShipOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'SHIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS shippedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelledOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'UNPAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'UNPAID' THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gmv, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'UNPAID' THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'UNPAID' THEN discount_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'UNPAID' THEN freight_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS freightAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'UNPAID' THEN cost_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS costAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'UNPAID' THEN gross_profit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS grossProfit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'UNPAID' THEN total_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalQuantity, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS orderUsers FROM ck_shop_order WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT order_status AS status, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS amount FROM ck_shop_order WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY order_status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM ck_shop_order WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS paidCount, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS gmv, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paidAmount FROM ck_shop_order WHERE pay_status <> 'UNPAID' AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{start} AND pay_time < #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.refund_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount FROM ck_shop_order_refund r WHERE r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.refund_time IS NOT NULL AND r.refund_time >= #{start} AND r.refund_time < #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.refund_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ck_shop_order WHERE order_status = 'CLOSED' AND paid_amount > 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ck_shop_order WHERE order_status = 'WAIT_PAY' AND pay_deadline IS NOT NULL AND pay_deadline < #{now}
